title: BenchWeave plugin-ui-class-reference composed action class 0.1.0
description: A vendor-authored action-class declaration: one versioned document that supplies the catalogue side of the derivation for action URNs no served catalog describes (layer 2 of the three-layer resolution, gateway #541 record section 3). The document claims action URNs explicitly (never a name-derivation guess), and the claims vocabulary is deliberately at least as permissive at the naming seam as the two layers it sits between: the OTDP descriptor puts no pattern on its action keys and layer 1's pinned vendor catalogs serve any key shape, so claims admits any versioned action key (owner ruling 2026-10-23) while class-action URNs in expect.controls stay otdp-namespaced, carries their input schema, and states one side effect from the closed set. It rides the descriptor's contracts[] pin seam (path plus sha256), plays the catalogue side of the D13 narrowing intersection unchanged, and never asserts presentation: the ladder still derives every control kind and reachability level. The document's own contract_version is the composed-action-class dialect version, deliberately decoupled from the family directory version so a pinned, digest-verified document stays valid across family bumps (the descriptor/otdp_version precedent); a dialect bump is a standards motion of its own.
